proposed_fixes.title: Image Resizer HEIC context-menu flow opens a file picker instead of resize options
proposed_fixes.root_cause: HEIC may be accepted inconsistently between Explorer context-menu input validation and image codec/extension support, causing the selected item to be treated as unsupported and reopening file selection.
plan: Trace HEIC selection from the Explorer context-menu handler through batch input validation and codec extension checks.
Unify supported-format validation and error handling so HEIC either resizes or is rejected clearly without an unrelated file picker.
Add an end-to-end context-menu test for HEIC when a supported codec is present and absent.
verification: Right-click a supported HEIC image and verify resize options open and a resized output is produced without another file picker.

confidence.rationale: The context-menu selection/codec support boundary is plausible, but closed #47840 does not alone establish that a fix shipped; later reports describe different outcomes.

comment.body: Thanks for noting that the extra picker once allowed resizing but that HEIC later stopped working entirely, and for linking the same symptom in #47840. Could you confirm the current PowerToys version and whether selecting the HEIC in the unexpected picker still produces output or fails? If possible, attach one small non-sensitive HEIC through the GitHub web UI. This distinguishes context-menu recognition from codec/output failure.
